# Fenjue (焚诀)

> Multi-agent unified memory & skill-routing governance framework: shared memory source via junctions, four-layer skill router (direct → tag → semantic → memory), quantified lessons-hit-rate, attention-budget ratchets, and a 28-check truth-consistency CI gate. Built and maintained as a single-person project with 150+ machine-verified iterations.

Agent skills are validated before publication by two content gates: zero-tolerance prompt-injection / credential-exfiltration scanning (`skill_security_scan`) and frontmatter conformance to the agentskills spec — description ≤1024 chars, required fields, frozen field whitelist (`skill_publish_compliance`).
